description: Removed provider-specific planner and its uncommitted continuation-history implementation. Generic connection details carry settings to existing AdapterOptions. User explicitly requested max_file_size everywhere, with no key translation: UI, persistence, and opts now use that name. Existing adapter owns validation and upload planning. New tests cover option forwarding across providers, actual create/edit, and adapter rejection. Multi-message splitting remains deferred.
title: Remove Mattermost file planning from shared bridge
